definitions.explanation: The social stratum between upper and lower class. Japan has historically had a strong middle-class identity.

definitions.gloss: midstream, middle reaches of a river
definitions.explanation: The middle section of a river, between the upper and lower reaches.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up in a middle-class household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中流|ちゅうりゅう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, many people consider themselves middle class.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}れ→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧、⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Middle-class consciousness is fading and inequality is widening.
I fished in the middle reaches of the river.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{域|いき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧だ。
examples.english: The midstream area has a gentle current.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧、{川幅|かわはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: From the upper to the middle reaches, the river gradually widens.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The phrase ⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{中流|ちゅうりゅう} (100 million people, all middle class) described Japan's post-war sense of economic equality. This {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (middle-class consciousness) has weakened since the 1990s.

FORMS:
⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {流|りゅう} (stream, class)

- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: middle-class household
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: middle-class consciousness
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧: middle class
